# flutter_boilerplate

> A Flutter Clean Architecture boilerplate/starter kit: feature-based
> package structure (core/domain/data/app), BLoC/Cubit state management,
> GetIt + Injectable dependency injection, Dio + Retrofit networking, and
> Hive CE + SharedPreferences local storage. One real feature (Home) is
> built out end-to-end across all layers as a worked example.

Use this repo as a reference or starting point when scaffolding a new
Flutter app that needs Clean Architecture layering, testable BLoC/Cubit
state, and a monorepo split into `core`/`domain`/`data`/app packages.
It intentionally documents its own gaps (no CI, single feature, partial
test coverage) instead of overclaiming — read Known Limitations in
README.md before treating it as production-ready as-is.

Key stack: Flutter 3.41.8 (via FVM), Dart 3.11.5, bloc/flutter_bloc 9.x
(Cubit pattern), go_router, dio + retrofit, hive_ce, get_it + injectable,
freezed, json_serializable, equatable, mockito.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): Tool-agnostic instructions for AI coding
  agents — setup commands, architecture rules, and the pre-completion
  check sequence.
- [README.md](./README.md): Project overview, architecture diagram, key
  stack rationale, quick start, common patterns (Result<T> error
  handling, Cubit state, DI composition), current test status, known
  limitations, and troubleshooting.
- [CLAUDE.md](./CLAUDE.md): Full feature-development guide — Clean
  Architecture layer conventions (domain/data/presentation), the
  Result<T> type, AppFailure hierarchy, DI registration and per-package
  build_runner rebuild steps, testing patterns (mockito, Cubit tests),
  and pitfalls already hit once (unregistered DI, circular package
  dependencies).
- [ERROR_BOUNDARY.md](./ERROR_BOUNDARY.md): How the app's error boundary
  widget catches build-time errors without crashing itself, including a
  bug found and fixed during testing.
- [TESTING_IMPLEMENTATION.md](./TESTING_IMPLEMENTATION.md): What test
  coverage actually exists today (use cases, entities, models) versus
  what's still missing (Cubit, repository, widget tests).

## Optional

- [pubspec.yaml](./pubspec.yaml): Root package manifest and dependency
  versions for the app package.
- [LICENSE](./LICENSE): MIT license terms.
